description: Company legal-entity lookup from the global LEI system (GLEIF). Send a company name or a 20-character LEI; returns legal name, LEI, status, jurisdiction, legal form, registration number, addresses, the first record's direct and ultimate parents, found or unknown, and provenance (source URLs, retrieval times, SHA-256). Use for know-your-business checks and group-structure questions. Companies only. Typical response 1 to 2 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.0099 (USDC, x402).
